raw_segments.text: Those pure immortal elements, that no, no gross, no unharmonious mixture foul eject him,
tainted now, and purge him off as a distemper gross to err as gross and mortal food.
As may dispose him best for dissolution wrought by sin, that first distempered all things
I at first with two fair gifts created him endowed, with happiness and immortality.
That fondly lost, this other served but to eternize woe.
